race.comment: ENJECTOR (3) has run well at both runs this time in, finding the line late fresh then running an eye-catching second last time on the Sunshine Coast. This easier and extra trip a plus. Gets  chance to break through. ELLOFABY (8) failed to figure again last time over 1700m at Gold Coast, beaten 10 lengths into eighth. Comes down a level this time. Senior rider sticks and solid claims on best form. Won't get a better chance to find the frame. BARTLE FRERE (1) led and finished ninth last start over 1400m at Sunshine Coast when he had be gassed early from an awkward barrier. Fares better at the draw this time. Capable of a big run and will take catching.  SHREWDNESS (2) is yet to fire in three runs for the new yard but gets chance.
